statements.__comment__: Merge ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT from NaisApp to its most recent NaisDeployment, but only when Kubernetes confirms the app is running (has_running_instance=true). For Applications this reflects live pod state; for Jobs this is always true since they run on a schedule.
statements.query: MATCH (a:NaisApp {has_running_instance: true})-[:HAS_DEPLOYMENT]->(d:NaisDeployment) WITH a, d ORDER BY d.created_at DESC WITH a, head(collect(d)) AS active_d MERGE (a)-[r:ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT]->(active_d) ON CREATE SET r.firstseen = timestamp() SET r.lastupdated = $UPDATE_TAG
MATCH (a:NaisApp)-[r:ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT]->(d:NaisDeployment) WHERE r.lastupdated <> $UPDATE_TAG WITH r LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DELETE r RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted
